correctness.rationale: The stationary Q operator gives exact two-point and ordered four-point velocity functions, hence the connected fourth correlation. Integration over ordered time gaps gives a rational Laplace transform and the explicit positive convolution H. Prékopa convolution log-concavity and real analyticity prove H’/H strictly decreases from infinity to zero. This yields the strict signs at all parameter boundaries and exactly one crossing otherwise. A 15x15 moment lift and independent 6x6 convolution cascade passed 567 numerical checks. No finite test is used to certify the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: Kurtosis is a natural observable for non-Gaussian active displacement and the approach to diffusive statistics. The theorem completely classifies all positive-time signs across the stationary two-rate run/rest family, shows that the asymptotic and initial signs can differ, identifies sharp golden-ratio and rate-two boundaries, and proves exactly one finite-time crossover using a structural log-concavity lemma. This is beyond a single-moment numerical benchmark or a routine MSD consequence.
